name: M4 Forecasting Competition Dataset
description: The M4 dataset comprises 100,000 real-world time series used in the 4th Makridakis International Forecasting Competition. The dataset spans diverse domains (demographic, finance, industry, macro, micro, and other) across six sampling frequencies (yearly, quarterly, monthly, weekly, daily, and hourly), serving as a benchmark for time-series forecasting algorithms.
